message.content:
**UNO – Official Rules Overview** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 1 000 points or finish all your own cards before anyone else does. Points come from opponents’ remaining cards when you win a round. | | **Deck** | Standard 108‑card set:
• Four colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) each with numbers 0–9 and action cards.
• Eight “Draw Two” (+2), eight “Skip”, eight “Reverse”.
• Twelve “Wild” and twelve “Wild Draw Four.” | --- ### Setup 1. Shuffle the full deck thoroughly. 2. Deal seven cards face down to each player; keep them secret. 3. Place the rest as a draw pile facedown next to the discard pile. 4. Flip the top card of the draw pile onto the discard pile to start the play area. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it's a Skip, the first player loses their turn). --- ### Turn Order & Play Players take turns clockwise unless a Reverse changes direction. On a player's turn: 1. **Match** one card from hand either by color, number, or symbol. *Example:* A Red 7 may replace a Yellow 7 or a Red “+2”. 2. **Play Wilds:** You may place a Wild or Wild Draw Four at any time regardless of what’s on the table. After playing a Wild, declare the new active color. 3. **If no match**, draw one card from the draw pile: - If this drawn card matches, you may play it immediately. - Otherwise, end your turn without drawing again until your next turn. *Special rule*: When you have only one card left, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so results in a penalty—drawing two more cards. --- ### Action Cards | Card | Effect | |------|--------| | **Draw Two (+2)** | Next player draws two cards and misses their turn. | | **Skip** | Next player skips their turn entirely. | | **Reverse** | Reverses the current direction of play. In a two‑player game, acts like a Skip. | | **Wild** | Player chooses the next color to play. | | **Wild Draw Four** | Same as Wild plus the next player draws four cards and forfeits their turn. Can only be played legally if the player has no matching colored card in hand. If challenged successfully, the challenger must instead draw six cards. | --- ### Winning a Round When a player discards their last card they call out “UNO” (if not already done earlier). That player wins the round. Score points based on opponent's leftover cards: - Numbered cards count as their numeric value. - +2, Skip, Reverse → 20 pts each. - Wild, Wild Draw Four → 50 pts each. Add those points to the winner’s total. Continue playing rounds until someone reaches ≥ 1000 points or agrees to stop after a predetermined number of rounds. --- ### Common House Variations | Variation | Description | |-----------|-------------| | **Stackable Draw Twos/Four** | Players may stack another +2/+4 on top of a previous one, forcing the next player to accumulate the sum rather than just drawing once. | | **No Penalty for Wrong UNO Call** | Some groups ignore the “UNO” shout requirement altogether. | | **Custom Deck Size** | Use fewer or extra cards to speed up gameplay. | | **“Crazy eights” style** | Replace Wild/Draw Four with custom rules such as “play any card that shares rank or suit.” | Feel free to tweak these rules to fit your group’s preferences!
